nodes.title: Setup and model downloads
widgets_values:
## LTX 2.5 any-video 2× pixel-spatial upscale

Select any short movie in **Load Video**, describe that existing clip in the prompt, then queue the workflow. ComfyUI supplies the movie frames, original audio, and detected FPS automatically. The source audio is copied to the finished movie after visual refinement; a silent source receives a silent track of matching duration.

1. Accept the license and download the five base files from [Lightricks/LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5).
2. Download [LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Pixel-Spatial-Upscaler](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Pixel-Spatial-Upscaler).
3. Put the transformer in `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`, Gemma in `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`, both VAEs in `ComfyUI/models/vae/`, the latent upscaler in `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`, and the IC-LoRA at `ComfyUI/models/loras/LTX-2.5/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-pixel-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors`. Shared model roots in `extra_model_paths.yaml` are supported.
4. Restart ComfyUI and select the source movie. Update the prompt, then **Queue the workflow**.

The recommended size policy center-crops only enough pixels to reach LTX's 32-pixel grid and records the exact crop in metadata. Select strict mode to reject instead. The output dimensions are twice the processed input dimensions.

This is model-based refinement, not a conventional resize filter. Runtime and unified-memory use grow rapidly with frame count and pixel area. Begin with a five-second source at roughly 640×384. `low_ram_streaming` reduces transformer residency but costs speed. The 0.35 refinement strength is conservative; higher values can recover more detail but may redraw the source.
